{"op":"set_pin","component":"M13","pin":"Source","net":"net16","why":"real M8 source joins the M1 drain / M10 drain node"},

]}

I'm working out that the pipeline's component labels don't line up with the schematic, so the netlist needs remapping before I can trust any edits. Next I'm matching its M1 and M2 entries against the PMOS input pair in the image, with M3 at the top center already accounted for.

I'm checking the pipeline's labels against the image, and several don't match: its "M5" entry is really M4, "M4" is M13, and some of the capacitor and MZ entries are shifted too. I'm going to lay out the full mapping before trusting any of the netlist edits.

Now I'm checking connectivity, which is hard with so many nodes tied to ground. I'll go through the nets one at a time to find the errors.

I'm checking the output node now: M6's drain, M8's drain, and the compensation elements all seem to meet there, so the "GND" label on M6's drain is wrong and should be the Vin net. The M1 drain comes down to the node between M8 and M10 around y≈210, which fits the folded-cascode layout.

I'm working out which side the output node's ground label belongs on. Voutn sits on the left, where the pipeline's C1 positive terminal and the top-row M12 and M14 connections meet, and the mislabeled Vin node near x≈208 ties together the other end of Cc1, M6's drain, and M8's drain.

Now I'm tracing which nets should carry the Vin node: the pipeline's M13 drain is labeled GND at (206,168), but it should be net13, and its source at (212,188) is also wrong. Checking M10's drain against M8's source, the M17 entry also seems to have its source labeled incorrectly.

Now I'm mapping the left-side components against the schematic, working out which real device each pipeline entry actually is and what its source and gate should connect to. I'm also settling the remaining right-side entries before I commit to the full set of netlist edits.

I'm checking the left-side components against the schematic now: M4's drain feeds net3 with its gate on Vb3, M6's drain should be the Vin node rather than GND, and M12's drain is the Voutn output. I'm also looking at the Cc1 capacitor, whose positive terminal goes to Voutn and negative terminal to net13, and I'm starting on MZ1 next.

I'm checking the MZ1 device next: its bottom terminal seems to go to ground, and its gate ties to net13, which is the Vin node.

I'm now going through the M11 and M10 terminals in the schematic, working out which one should be ground and which should stay on the Vin net, before settling the M11 gate.

I'm settling the connections for the right-hand capacitor and the M11 gate. Its drain should be ground and its gate the Vip node, so only the source needs changing to ground as well. The capacitor's positive side goes to Vip and its negative side to Voutp, which makes net13 the Vin node.

I'm settling the MZ1 terminals now: the gate sits on net13, the Vin node, and the drain and source both look like they should go to ground.

I'm settling the left-side MZ1 and M11 fixes: M10's gate stays on the Vin net with both its other terminals to ground, and for M11 the drain and gate are swapped so the gate sits on the Vip node, with its source moved to ground. Now I'm moving on to the bottom-left NMOS, M14, whose drain already sits on Voutn.

I'm checking whether M14's gate line runs across to the node near x≈208, which would make it a common-mode feedback connection, while noting that the MZ1 ground wire crosses that same height.

I'm matching the remaining netlist entries against the schematic: M15's gate should be on the same node as M8's source and M10's drain, and its source to ground, while the right-side M14 needs its gate moved to the right-hand node and its source to ground. I'm also noting that M12's drain should be net14 rather than ground, and M9 sits on the same net18 as the other right-side devices.

I'm checking whether M2's gate should be Vip, and whether M1's gate on the left connects to the Vin node through the wire near x≈240.

Now I'm settling M8's gate, which should sit on the Vin node (net13) rather than net17, and I'm questioning whether its body tie is wrong, since a PMOS body usually belongs to VDD or its source.

I'm going through the remaining right-side netlist entries now, starting with M9's gate and body, where the gate should sit on net14 and the body tie can go. I'm also checking M8's drain and M3's connections, which look fine, before moving on to M1, M6, and M4.

I'm checking the pipeline's M4 entry, which should feed net15 rather than the dangling net7 at the Voutp node, so I'll merge them. The left-side M13 and M17 entries need their drains, sources, and gates reassigned to net13, net16, and GND, and I'm tying net16 to the M8 drain, the M17 drain, and the M15 gate.

Now I'm going through the netlist fixes in order: reattaching the M6 and M12 drains to the Vip node, moving M13's drain and source onto the Vin and M16 nets, and clearing M17's source to ground. Then I'm dropping the bogus body ties on M8 and M9 and pointing their gates at the right nodes, before handling M10, M11, M14, M15 and M4.

I'm confirming that M12 in the pipeline is really the NMOS device, which matches the bubble-less symbol in the image, so that entry is correct as it stands.
